name: Seo Marketing Checklist
author: pressreleasereviews

sections.description:
Seo Marketing Checklist is a simple checklist you can use to easily advertise and promote your website. Quick access to the best seo tools so you can quickly promote your website.

For plugin support please visit the WordPress.org plugin support page at https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/seo-marketing-checklist

For more information about the plugin please visit https://pressreleaseviews.com
sections.installation:
Option 1. Upload, install and then activate the plugin through the wordpress dashboard.

Option 2. Extract and upload the zip files contents directly to the directory /wp-content/plugins/seo-marketing-checklist and then go to the installed plugins page in your WordPress dashboard and activate the plugin.
sections.faq:
What minimum version of WordPress is required?

This plugin requires minimum version 5.4 or later of WordPress.

What are the licensing terms?

This plugin is available for free under the GNU General Public License, Version 2.

What is the latest tested version of WordPress this is compatible with?

This plugin has been tested up to version 5.4 of WordPress.

Does this plugin have any issues with any other plugins or themes?

This plugin is safe and fully tested with all current version of WordPress. Works fine with all other plugins, works perfectly with yoast wordpress seo plugin, contact form 7, akismet, also jetpack, and also works perfectly with any theme, no compatibility issues with any plugins or any other themes. This plugin is tested and safe for your wp site or blog and fully responsive and tested in all browsers.
